t: Japan bars Indian mango shipments after inspectors found problems at vapour heat treatment facilities (six varieties, certificates issued from 25 March).
China revokes import licences of three Indian rice exporters after customs rejected consignments over alleged GMO traces. Exporters dispute the finding.
Hong Kong suspends several Indian spice products over pesticide residues (reported date not given).
EU raises inspection frequency on Indian cumin to 30% of consignments.
About 70 non-basmati rice consignments reported rejected by China in 2026, with at least 200 containers held back (figures from a press report).
